title: 大型港口沉箱碼頭
subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
summary: 將回填土水壓船舶作用與地基變形連成沉箱碼頭受力路徑。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
summaryEn: Trace caisson-quay load paths through backfill, water, vessels and foundation deformation. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「主動土壓假設」與「有效土壓積分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Active earth-pressure assumptions" and "Effective earth-pressure integration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 主動土壓假設：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Active earth-pressure assumptions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「主動土壓假設」如何影響大型港口沉箱碼頭的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Active earth-pressure assumptions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-port caisson quay walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 碼頭背填土會把側向作用傳入沉箱，但是否達到主動狀態取決於牆體位移及土體條件。簡單朗肯係數假設水平無黏性回填與光滑直立牆，與靜止土壓不同；港區受限位移、分層或密實施工時，不能僅憑摩擦角選一個較小係數。 假設水平無黏性回填、光滑直立牆且已達主動狀態，φ=30°，Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333；不適用靜止狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「主動土壓假設」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill transfers lateral action into a caisson, but mobilizing an active state requires compatible wall movement and soil conditions. The simple Rankine coefficient assumes level cohesionless backfill and a smooth vertical wall, distinct from at-rest pressure. Restricted deformation, layering or compaction means friction angle alone cannot justify selecting the smaller coefficient for every quay-wall condition. Assume level cohesionless fill, a smooth vertical wall and mobilized active conditions. Atφ=30°,Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333, not at-rest pressure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Active earth-pressure assumptions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有碼頭背填土都不需牆體變形就會自動達到主動土壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every quay backfill automatically reaches active pressure without any wall movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「主動土壓假設」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Active earth-pressure assumptions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主動土壓假設
knowledge.text: 碼頭背填土會把側向作用傳入沉箱，但是否達到主動狀態取決於牆體位移及土體條件。簡單朗肯係數假設水平無黏性回填與光滑直立牆，與靜止土壓不同；港區受限位移、分層或密實施工時，不能僅憑摩擦角選一個較小係數。
knowledge.textEn: Backfill transfers lateral action into a caisson, but mobilizing an active state requires compatible wall movement and soil conditions. The simple Rankine coefficient assumes level cohesionless backfill and a smooth vertical wall, distinct from at-rest pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有碼頭背填土都不需牆體變形就會自動達到主動土壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every quay backfill automatically reaches active pressure without any wall movement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「大型港口沉箱碼頭」的「主動土壓假設：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海岸水槽與港區實驗」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Active earth-pressure assumptions: mechanism and system paths” in “Large-port caisson quay walls”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Coastal flume and harbor experiments” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「主動土壓假設」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Active earth-pressure assumptions" is correct?
options: 所有碼頭背填土都不需牆體變形就會自動達到主動土壓。
碼頭背填土會把側向作用傳入沉箱，但是否達到主動狀態取決於牆體位移及土體條件。
使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。
optionsEn: Every quay backfill automatically reaches active pressure without any wall movement.
Backfill transfers lateral action into a caisson, but mobilizing an active state requires compatible wall movement and soil conditions.
Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure.
quiz.explanation: 碼頭背填土會把側向作用傳入沉箱，但是否達到主動狀態取決於牆體位移及土體條件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Backfill transfers lateral action into a caisson, but mobilizing an active state requires compatible wall movement and soil conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主動土壓假設：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Active earth-pressure assumptions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主動土壓假設」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Active earth-pressure assumptions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設水平無黏性回填、光滑直立牆且已達主動狀態，φ=30°，Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333；不適用靜止狀態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume level cohesionless fill, a smooth vertical wall and mobilized active conditions. Atφ=30°,Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333, not at-rest pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設水平無黏性回填、光滑直立牆且已達主動狀態，φ=30°，Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333；不適用靜止狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume level cohesionless fill, a smooth vertical wall and mobilized active conditions. Atφ=30°,Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333, not at-rest pressure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主動土壓假設」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Active earth-pressure assumptions", which statement holds?
options: 回填內水位總是與外海潮位同步所以不必量測孔壓。
靠泊能量增加一倍就表示護舷峰值反力一定增加一倍。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Backfill water always follows the harbor tide exactly, making pore-pressure measurements unnecessary.
Doubling berthing energy necessarily doubles the fender's peak reaction force.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主動土壓假設：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Active earth-pressure assumptions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主動土壓假設」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Active earth-pressure assumptions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。分開檢查施工壓密與服務期約束，用土樣與位移紀錄確認參數，不以單一公式取代狀態辨識。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state. Review compaction and service constraints separately and use soil and displacement records to justify parameters rather than substituting one formula for identification of the stress state. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。分開檢查施工壓密與服務期約束，用土樣與位移紀錄確認參數，不以單一公式取代狀態辨識。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state. Review compaction and service constraints separately and use soil and displacement records to justify parameters rather than substituting one formula for identification of the stress state.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：剛性受限牆體未達主動位移卻採主動係數會低估側壓，黏性回填或坡面改變也使假設失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using active pressure for a restrained wall understates lateral action, and cohesive fill or altered slopes violate the assumptions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。分開檢查施工壓密與服務期約束，用土樣與位移紀錄確認參數，不以單一公式取代狀態辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state. Review compaction and service constraints separately and use soil and displacement records to justify parameters rather than substituting one formula for identification of the stress state.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。分開檢查施工壓密與服務期約束，用土樣與位移紀錄確認參數，不以單一公式取代狀態辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state. Review compaction and service constraints separately and use soil and displacement records to justify parameters rather than substituting one formula for identification of the stress state.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主動土壓假設」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Active earth-pressure assumptions"?
options: 畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
加重沉箱只增加抵抗力而不會增加任何地震慣性需求。
optionsEn: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Increasing caisson mass raises resistance without increasing any seismic inertia demand.
quiz.explanation: 畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主動土壓假設：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Active earth-pressure assumptions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主動土壓假設」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Active earth-pressure assumptions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 剛性受限牆體未達主動位移卻採主動係數會低估側壓，黏性回填或坡面改變也使假設失效。施工時壓密設備可能留下高於單純自重理論的壓力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using active pressure for a restrained wall understates lateral action, and cohesive fill or altered slopes violate the assumptions. Compaction equipment may also leave pressures greater than predicted by a simple self-weight active model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設水平無黏性回填、光滑直立牆且已達主動狀態，φ=30°，Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333；不適用靜止狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Atφ=30°,Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333, not at-rest pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有碼頭背填土都不需牆體變形就會自動達到主動土壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every quay backfill automatically reaches active pressure without any wall movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 剛性受限牆體未達主動位移卻採主動係數會低估側壓，黏性回填或坡面改變也使假設失效。施工時壓密設備可能留下高於單純自重理論的壓力。
knowledge.textEn: Using active pressure for a restrained wall understates lateral action, and cohesive fill or altered slopes violate the assumptions. Compaction equipment may also leave pressures greater than predicted by a simple self-weight active model.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主動土壓假設」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Active earth-pressure assumptions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
剛性受限牆體未達主動位移卻採主動係數會低估側壓，黏性回填或坡面改變也使假設失效。
使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using active pressure for a restrained wall understates lateral action, and cohesive fill or altered slopes violate the assumptions.
Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure.
quiz.explanation: 剛性受限牆體未達主動位移卻採主動係數會低估側壓，黏性回填或坡面改變也使假設失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using active pressure for a restrained wall understates lateral action, and cohesive fill or altered slopes violate the assumptions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 有效土壓積分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective earth-pressure integration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效土壓積分」如何影響大型港口沉箱碼頭的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective earth-pressure integration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-port caisson quay walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水下回填的土骨架壓力與孔隙水壓必須分開，使用浮重度積分的是有效土壓而不是總側壓。深度線性分布只涵蓋均質填料自重，分層和地面堆載另列；將孔壓漏掉或重複計入都會破壞沉箱整體平衡與作用點判讀。 假設Ka=1/3、浮重度10kN/m³、高H=15m，Pa=Kaγ′H²/2=375kN/m，作用在底上5m；水壓另算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效土壓積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Effective skeleton pressure in submerged fill must be separated from pore pressure. Integration with submerged unit weight gives effective soil action, not total lateral action. A linear distribution covers homogeneous self-weight only; layers and surcharges require separate terms. Omitting or double-counting water pressure corrupts both caisson equilibrium and interpretation of the resultant location along the wall. Assume Ka=1/3,submerged unit weight10kN/m³ and H=15m. Pa=375kN/m acts5m above base; pore-water pressure is separate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective earth-pressure integration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效土壓積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective earth-pressure integration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效土壓積分
knowledge.text: 水下回填的土骨架壓力與孔隙水壓必須分開，使用浮重度積分的是有效土壓而不是總側壓。深度線性分布只涵蓋均質填料自重，分層和地面堆載另列；將孔壓漏掉或重複計入都會破壞沉箱整體平衡與作用點判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Effective skeleton pressure in submerged fill must be separated from pore pressure. Integration with submerged unit weight gives effective soil action, not total lateral action.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有效土壓積分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective earth-pressure integration" is correct?
options: 使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。
全場平均堆載可以直接代表貼近岸壁的所有局部輪壓。
水下回填的土骨架壓力與孔隙水壓必須分開，使用浮重度積分的是有效土壓而不是總側壓。
optionsEn: Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure.
The terminal-average surcharge directly represents every concentrated wheel load near the quay edge.
Effective skeleton pressure in submerged fill must be separated from pore pressure.
quiz.explanation: 水下回填的土骨架壓力與孔隙水壓必須分開，使用浮重度積分的是有效土壓而不是總側壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective skeleton pressure in submerged fill must be separated from pore pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效土壓積分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective earth-pressure integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效土壓積分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective earth-pressure integration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Ka=1/3、浮重度10kN/m³、高H=15m，Pa=Kaγ′H²/2=375kN/m，作用在底上5m；水壓另算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Ka=1/3,submerged unit weight10kN/m³ and H=15m. Pa=375kN/m acts5m above base; pore-water pressure is separate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐層畫有效土壓和水壓圖，標明水位及每個三角形的作用點，積分後重建合力與力矩。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot effective-soil and water-pressure diagrams with levels and resultant locations, then reconstruct total force and moment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Ka=1/3、浮重度10kN/m³、高H=15m，Pa=Kaγ′H²/2=375kN/m，作用在底上5m；水壓另算。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Ka=1/3,submerged unit weight10kN/m³ and H=15m. Pa=375kN/m acts5m above base; pore-water pressure is separate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效土壓積分」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective earth-pressure integration", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
基底平均壓力不大就足以證明邊緣接觸與承載都沒有問題。
護舷載入曲線下面積全部等於不可恢復的永久耗散能量。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A modest mean base pressure proves that edge contact and foundation capacity are satisfactory.
All work under the fender loading curve is irreversibly dissipated energy.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 有效土壓積分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective earth-pressure integration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效土壓積分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective earth-pressure integration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐層畫有效土壓和水壓圖，標明水位及每個三角形的作用點，積分後重建合力與力矩。核對浮重度來源，將船舶、堆載及地震作用分開，避免相同水壓被不同表格重複加入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot effective-soil and water-pressure diagrams with levels and resultant locations, then reconstruct total force and moment. Verify submerged unit weight and keep vessel, surcharge and seismic terms separate so the same water action is not added twice in different tables. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：逐層畫有效土壓和水壓圖，標明水位及每個三角形的作用點，積分後重建合力與力矩。核對浮重度來源，將船舶、堆載及地震作用分開，避免相同水壓被不同表格重複加入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Plot effective-soil and water-pressure diagrams with levels and resultant locations, then reconstruct total force and moment. Verify submerged unit weight and keep vessel, surcharge and seismic terms separate so the same water action is not added twice in different tables.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以飽和重度積分後又加完整水壓可能高估作用，僅用浮重度卻不加水壓則低估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using saturated unit weight and then adding full water pressure can overcount action, while submerged weight alone omits water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐層畫有效土壓和水壓圖，標明水位及每個三角形的作用點，積分後重建合力與力矩。核對浮重度來源，將船舶、堆載及地震作用分開，避免相同水壓被不同表格重複加入。
knowledge.textEn: Plot effective-soil and water-pressure diagrams with levels and resultant locations, then reconstruct total force and moment. Verify submerged unit weight and keep vessel, surcharge and seismic terms separate so the same water action is not added twice in different tables.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 逐層畫有效土壓和水壓圖，標明水位及每個三角形的作用點，積分後重建合力與力矩。核對浮重度來源，將船舶、堆載及地震作用分開，避免相同水壓被不同表格重複加入。
knowledge.textEn: Plot effective-soil and water-pressure diagrams with levels and resultant locations, then reconstruct total force and moment. Verify submerged unit weight and keep vessel, surcharge and seismic terms separate so the same water action is not added twice in different tables.

quiz.question: 要驗證「有效土壓積分」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective earth-pressure integration"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
逐層畫有效土壓和水壓圖，標明水位及每個三角形的作用點，積分後重建合力與力矩。
全碼頭平均沉陷不大即可保證起重機軌道不會扭曲。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Plot effective-soil and water-pressure diagrams with levels and resultant locations, then reconstruct total force and moment.
Small average quay settlement guarantees that crane rails cannot distort.
quiz.explanation: 逐層畫有效土壓和水壓圖，標明水位及每個三角形的作用點，積分後重建合力與力矩。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot effective-soil and water-pressure diagrams with levels and resultant locations, then reconstruct total force and moment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 有效土壓積分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective earth-pressure integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效土壓積分」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective earth-pressure integration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以飽和重度積分後又加完整水壓可能高估作用，僅用浮重度卻不加水壓則低估。合力數值碰巧相近時，錯誤作用點仍可能使傾覆力矩嚴重偏離。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using saturated unit weight and then adding full water pressure can overcount action, while submerged weight alone omits water. Even coincidentally similar total forces can have incorrect resultant locations and materially wrong overturning moments. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設Ka=1/3、浮重度10kN/m³、高H=15m，Pa=Kaγ′H²/2=375kN/m，作用在底上5m；水壓另算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pa=375kN/m acts5m above base; pore-water pressure is separate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以飽和重度積分後又加完整水壓可能高估作用，僅用浮重度卻不加水壓則低估。合力數值碰巧相近時，錯誤作用點仍可能使傾覆力矩嚴重偏離。
knowledge.textEn: Using saturated unit weight and then adding full water pressure can overcount action, while submerged weight alone omits water. Even coincidentally similar total forces can have incorrect resultant locations and materially wrong overturning moments.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「有效土壓積分」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective earth-pressure integration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
全場平均堆載可以直接代表貼近岸壁的所有局部輪壓。
以飽和重度積分後又加完整水壓可能高估作用，僅用浮重度卻不加水壓則低估。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The terminal-average surcharge directly represents every concentrated wheel load near the quay edge.
Using saturated unit weight and then adding full water pressure can overcount action, while submerged weight alone omits water.
quiz.explanation: 以飽和重度積分後又加完整水壓可能高估作用，僅用浮重度卻不加水壓則低估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using saturated unit weight and then adding full water pressure can overcount action, while submerged weight alone omits water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
